summary: Phase 20 converts the Phase 19 multi-pass modeling policy from documentation into machine-enforced bridge invariants in bridge_cli.py verify-report. Review corrections (same branch) strengthened the trust boundary in _check_payload_provenance and added HEAD/result_commit verification.

review_corrections.bypass_1_fixed: Authorization was previously read from the result-commit manifest, allowing an operator to self-authorize by changing local_modeling_authorized=false to true. Fix: authorization is now read exclusively from the base-commit manifest. The result manifest is still parsed for SHA/identity cross-checks, but local_modeling_authorized comes only from base.
review_corrections.bypass_2_fixed: If the controller payload (manifest.json + rhino.py) did not exist at base_commit, the old comparison (base_rhino is None) silently skipped the modification check, allowing a fabricated payload to pass. Fix: both manifest.json and rhino.py are now required to exist at base_commit; absence is a hard PROVENANCE_ERROR.
review_corrections.bypass_3_fixed: verify-report only checked that result_commit was a well-formed 40-char hex string. Fix: result_commit is now validated as a real git object (git cat-file -e) and must equal the current HEAD, enforcing that verify-report is run before the receipt commit.

trust_boundary_rules.authorization_source: base_commit manifest only — operator cannot self-authorize by altering the result manifest
trust_boundary_rules.payload_origin_required_at_base: Both manifest.json and rhino.py must exist at base_commit for a payload task
trust_boundary_rules.payload_immutability_when_not_authorized: result manifest and rhino.py must be byte-for-byte identical to base manifest and rhino.py
trust_boundary_rules.result_commit_validated: Must exist as a git object and equal current HEAD at verify time
trust_boundary_rules.review_signal: Parent report presence at base_commit is the machine proxy for controller review/merge of the parent pass

invariants_implemented.description: Payload provenance trigger: when .bridge/payloads/<task-id>/manifest.json exists at result_commit, provenance checks apply.
Fabrication prevention: manifest.json and rhino.py must both exist at base_commit. If either is absent, verification fails.
Controller authorship: author_role=controller must be present in base_commit manifest.
Base integrity: SHA-256 of rhino.py at base_commit must match manifest.sha256 at base_commit.
Self-authorization prevention: local_modeling_authorized is read from base manifest only. If base=false but result=true, verification fails.
Payload immutability: when local_modeling_authorized=false (per base manifest), result manifest and rhino.py must be byte-for-byte identical to their base versions.
Authorized modification: when local_modeling_authorized=true, result rhino.py SHA-256 must match result manifest.sha256.
result_commit existence: git cat-file -e must succeed for report.result_commit.
result_commit = HEAD: current HEAD must equal report.result_commit at verify time (enforces pre-receipt workflow).
Multi-pass activation: triggered when manifest carries a non-empty modeling_run_id.
pass_index must be a positive integer; pass_kind must be in {foundation, correction, detail_qa, hotfix, single_pass}; requires_controller_review_after must be boolean if present.
Foundation pass (pass_index=1, non-hotfix): reject parent lineage fields if present.
pass_index > 1: require parent_task_id, parent_payload_sha256, parent_result_commit. Resolve parent from base_commit only.
Parent report must exist at base_commit (machine signal for controller review/merge).
Parent report result_commit must equal manifest.parent_result_commit.
Parent payload manifest sha256 must equal manifest.parent_payload_sha256; modeling_run_id must match; pass_index must equal parent+1.
Multi-pass tasks must commit .bridge/evidence/<task-id>/pass-evaluation.json at result_commit.
pass-evaluation fields task_id, modeling_run_id, pass_index, pass_kind, executed_payload_sha256 must match the manifest.
operator_recommendation_scope must equal 'evidence_only'.
When local_modeling_authorized=false: reject if local_modeling_used=true or payload_modified_by_operator=true in pass-evaluation.

backward_compatibility.non_payload_tasks: No manifest at result_commit → all Phase-20 checks skipped. Existing reports pass unchanged.
backward_compatibility.single_pass_payload_tasks: Manifest present but no modeling_run_id → provenance checked, lineage and pass-evaluation skipped.
backward_compatibility.protocol_version: 0.3 — no version bump required. Checks are additive.

new_command.name: next-pass-context
new_command.description: Non-mutating helper. Reads parent report + manifest from current checkout, prints JSON with modeling_run_id, next_pass_index, parent_task_id, parent_payload_sha256, parent_result_commit, parent_pass_kind. Does not author geometry.

files_changed.change: Added hashlib+subprocess imports; PAYLOADS, EVIDENCE, SHA_RE, VALID_PASS_KINDS constants; _git_show_bytes, _git_show_json, _check_payload_provenance (strengthened trust boundary), _check_multipass_lineage, _check_pass_evaluation helpers; extended cmd_verify_report with result_commit existence/HEAD-match checks; added cmd_next_pass_context; added next-pass-context dispatch in main().

20-case fixture test suite. All tests call verify-report before receipt commit (matching real workflow). Covers all invariants including 6 new review-correction cases: self-authorization attack, fabricated payload attack, result manifest changed, result rhino.py changed, nonexistent result_commit, result_commit != HEAD.
Added provenance fields: local_modeling_used, local_modeling_authorized, payload_modified_by_operator, provenance_check.
Added enforcement notice in core principle section.
Added machine-enforcement notices for payload and lineage checks; updated pass-evaluation path.
Updated multi-pass loop note to specify canonical pass-evaluation.json path and note machine enforcement.

validations.json_valid: All modified JSON files validated via json.load
validations.rhino_runtime_unchanged: No Rhino/MCP runtime implementation files modified

known_limitations: next-pass-context reads from the current working tree, not a specific commit. Controllers should run it from a clean up-to-date checkout after the parent pass is merged.
The parent report presence at base_commit is used as the proxy for controller review/merge. There is no protocol-level signature; a manually inserted report file would satisfy the check.
Pass-evaluation schema is validated for key fields only; free-form fields like measurements and capture_artifacts are not schema-checked by verify-report.
verify-report runs git operations from ROOT; if called outside a git repository it will fail with a subprocess error rather than a clear bridge error.
